Explanation: Line 15 in expandFile is inside the while loop and is part of the argument evaluation for the `extractFile` call at line 13, so it is reachable when a zip entry exists. The call enters `extractFile` at line 1. Line 34 is in the else branch of `if (isDirectory)` at line 23, so it requires `isDirectory` to be false. In `expandFile`, `isDirectory` is passed from `ze.isDirectory()`, which can be false for a normal file entry. The earlier guard at lines 12-14 can also be false, so line 34 is reachable. At line 34, `new FileOutputStream(f)` can throw `FileNotFoundException`, so the path can cause an exception.

Answer: Yes
